subject.title: Voice transcript recovery turn generates response but delivery-mirror drops Telegram reply

question: Should this issue be promoted to live Telegram reproduction/root-cause work now, or wait for reporter evidence before choosing a fix boundary?
rationale: The report is plausible and high impact, but source inspection did not identify one safe narrow code change that proves where the generated recovery reply is lost.

options.title: Run live Telegram proof first
options.body: Reproduce a voice or forwarded-voice transcript recovery turn on current main, capture redacted delivery-mirror/session evidence, then choose the repair boundary.

options.title: Wait for reporter details
options.body: Keep the issue open with a request for redacted logs or a fresh recording before assigning engineering time.

options.title: Fold into adjacent delivery work
options.body: Treat it as follow-up context for broader Telegram delivery-mirror fixes, at the cost of leaving the exact voice recovery case unproven.

recommendation.title: Run live Telegram proof first
recommendation.body: Reproduce a voice or forwarded-voice transcript recovery turn on current main, capture redacted delivery-mirror/session evidence, then choose the repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant recent merged work is the queued follow-up/final-reply delivery path adjacent to this report.
